Background:
The fair maiden of water graces the evening ball in full bloom.
 Her formal attire gifted from a cherished friend and the preparations made toward delivering gracious hospitality are all for the one she loves most.
 She entrusts the dance to convey her feelings while shining brilliantly in her castle under the night sky.
Background_JP:
夜宴の舞台に咲き誇るは、煌びやかなる水星の美姫。
敬愛する者より賜りし夜会服も、趣向を凝らした歓待の支度も、すべては愛しき人のため。
尊き想いを舞踊に託し、美姫は夜の居城にて、ひときわ眩い輝きを放つ。
